Synthetic FHIR transaction Bundle: only resource ids, urn:uuid fullUrls and HL7/LOINC/UCUM canonical URLs, no real PHI. The file name contains 'patient', which makes every long token sensitive-context, so standards URLs and kebab-case ids trip the scanner; digest pinned and expiring

notes: Digest-bound exceptions only: every entry names one exact file, one exact sha256, one owner role and one expiry date. Wildcards, permanent exclusions and directory scopes are rejected by tools/phi-scan/rules.py (allow-invalid). The entries cover the official HL7 R4 CC0 example corpus and its derived negative control; they require privacy-lead countersignature and re-approval before expiry. The single custom rule adds a hard block on committed AWS-style access key identifiers. Its pattern deliberately cannot match its own literal text, so the rules file never self-blocks.
